svg.title: Twin skaters link hands and spin
svg.desc: Two equal skaters glide on parallel paths, link hands, and rotate about their center of mass. Their angular momentum is the same before and after. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Linking hands turns straight-line motion into a spin
Equal skaters, equal speeds, paths 2r apart. With no external torque, angular momentum about the
center of mass is the same before and after.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
